reading_route.title: Addressable external evidence enters another owner’s work

section.claim_ref: External DRS was exercised through independent local Roots and actual receiving Work; G52, G54C and D1 have distinct experimental roles.
DRS is semantic topology and addressable relations; dense artifacts can remain with their owner behind pointers.
The G52 receiver has a persisted pointer-only lookup before body retrieval.
Requester retrieval, publisher release and receiver use have separate local grounds; foreign acceptance does not replace receiver authority.
E, B and C preserve the producer result through publication and independently derived consumption context.
The numerical probe produced 23/35 from 7/11 and 31/47 after consuming computed + sample + request_revision, with nine recorded negative controls.
G52 changed its imported correction from −10 to −4, producing 96 then 102 under unchanged readings and limit 100 while preserving old history.
External source validity is half-open and bounded by validity,TTL and source age; signed status freshness is checked separately.
The receiver stores authentic terminal status before refusing current use.
A genuinely new B process reloads state and rejects saved old ACTIVE as rollback; a lawful new source revision continues.
Three ordinary history queries each use one new local read review with no remote sends or new Work; supplied verification makes no Root decisions.
G52 baseline has 12 attempts, 8 permitted metadata, 2 permitted payload, 2 denied payload and 2 bodies / 2,146 bytes; the publisher refuses extra disclosure.
Duplicate delivery has one source/history and zero credit; unknown status remains unknown and lawful new evidence permits continuation.
F01–F20 combines recorded native lifecycle and coherent pure controls with declared limits.
The G53 reviewed local body-profile seam supports different content; historical G52 uses its own pinned contracts.
Two independent G55 proof processes produce identical 37,389-byte canonical output while invoking only selected pure G52/D1 verifiers.
The trusted reference includes reviewed sources, observer, runner, pinned inputs and examiner; signed transport is not encryption or production identity.
Searchable permitted descriptions could support cooperation among independent owners without pooling their full archives.
Work produces new conclusions; DRS can make permitted results and richer traces addressable with lineage for later work.
External service capability use and local implementation admission are separate extension paths.
Reflective Improvement Radiolaria, Cross-Domain Transfer Radiolaria, Capability Synthesis Factory and global discovery remain deferred.
An external descriptor identifies material before its body is obtained.
The receiving owner reviews retrieval and the source owner separately controls disclosure.
New correction evidence changes the local result from 96 to 102 while the limit stays 100.
Source age, status freshness and current use have distinct temporal conditions.
Persisted revocation survives the tested process restart while past success remains history.
Scoped budgets, duplicate handling and negative history bound exploration and continuation.
Calibration and football reuse an accepted exchange with distinct closed content profiles.
E, B and C preserve meaning through independently checked provenance and status joins.
Addressable evidence supports an architectural path toward cooperation between owners.
Integrated Factory, Cognitive Radiolaria and global discovery remain deferred.

reading_route.orientation: A descriptor can travel while rich source material stays with its owner. Discovery, local retrieval permission, publisher disclosure, verification and local use are distinct steps.
E is a producing Work result. B contains E plus actual provenance and publication. C contains B plus independently checked current status. They are linked representations, not identical files.
Controlled calibration: 106 + (100 − 110) = 96, then 106 + (100 − 104) = 102. The receiving limit remains 100; its earlier 96 remains history.

Terminal revocation, restart of B with preserved state, refusal of stale ACTIVE, later lawful revision, budgets and bounded history are recorded. Full rollback of all machine snapshots was not tested.

Future federation, global discovery and capability catalogs are architectural directions. The G5 exchange used separate processes and signed IPC; it did not implement public internet PKI or automatic program installation.
